Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-research.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Select and assess final-decision abstention on separate development folds under the repaired risk-coverage/reliability contract. Coverage uses all eligible units; no calibration claim from a single film.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: research. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Research comparison retained; frozen exposure/eligibility rules apply. Not an engineering prerequisite or proof of behavioral recovery.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 3 H4.

Uses Phase 2's support-honesty wire, the final-decision reliability contract and the repaired risk-coverage instrument.

Scope:
Development only.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The abstention policy is selected on development data.
2. Risk-coverage is computed on the final decision, with coverage against all gold-eligible units.
3. Reliability is assessed on held-out development folds; no calibration claim is made from one film.
4. Each sub-arm has a ledger entry before its first gold read and runs through recall-map on development data only.
5. Each sub-arm is compared with the current best development configuration on the pre-declared participant-average estimand.
6. The outcome of each sub-arm is recorded as adopt, reject or unavailable, with the evidence; adoption changes the shipping candidate only through a committed config change.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: M.
